cohort: The study included 219 mothers aged 20-40 years with recent singleton births.
finding: The study found a high prevalence of PPD (66.21%) in Sindh, Pakistan, which was significantly associated with various maternal, neonatal, and socioeconomic risk factors including maternal age, BMI, education, income, and multiparity.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with Post Partum Depression.
